entries.sense_en: to measure how deep water is by lowering a line

synonyms.nuance: Technical sailors' word for measuring depth with a weighted line; fathom also means understand.
synonyms.example: They sounded the channel before entering.

synonyms.nuance: General word for finding any size; says nothing about depth or water.
synonyms.example: measure the length of the room

entries.tip_ko: '이해하다'라는 비유 뜻으로도 자주 쓰입니다: I can't fathom why he left.

entries.sense_en: bending easily without breaking

synonyms.nuance: Most common word; used for materials, plans and people alike.
Suggests smooth, graceful bending, as in skin, leather or a body.
Almost the same, but also often means easily influenced.

entries.sense_en: a stirring or shaking movement, here of the water

synonyms.nuance: Broader: any interruption of calm, physical or social.
Noisy, confused activity, usually among people.

entries.tip_ko: 사람에게는 '불안, 초조'라는 뜻으로 더 자주 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: a jeweled headband worn by a queen or king

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word; a diadem is a lighter, band-like or jeweled ornament.
A jeweled half-circle worn by women at formal events, not a sign of rule.

entries.sense_en: unusual and strange; unlike anything else

synonyms.nuance: Strange in an odd or slightly uncomfortable way.
Worth noticing, usually in a good way.
Plain, neutral word for not common.

entries.sense_en: to move smoothly and quietly

synonyms.nuance: Moves across a surface, often with contact and friction.
Moves slowly without control or aim.
Just describes moving through water; glide adds smoothness and ease.

entries.sense_en: to manage a home: cooking, cleaning and running daily life

synonyms.nuance: More modern and formal; stresses being in charge.
Only the chores, not the managing.

entries.sense_en: for that reason

synonyms.nuance: Plain, current wording of the same idea.
synonyms.example: For that reason, we left early.

synonyms.nuance: One-word, more formal link between cause and result.

entries.sense_en: back and forth, moving one way then the other

synonyms.example: The boat bobbed up and down.

entries.sense_en: a soft, glowing light

synonyms.nuance: Softer and warmer; common in speech.
A small, brief flash of light.

entries.sense_en: the green outer cup that holds a flower's petals

synonyms.nuance: One leaf-like piece of the calyx; the calyx is all of them together.
The colored inner part, not the green cup around it.

entries.tip_ko: 식물학 용어로 일상 영어에서는 거의 안 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: a light or faint shade of a color

synonyms.nuance: Any variety of one color, darker or lighter.
More literary; the basic color quality.
A slight trace of color or feeling.

entries.sense_en: the long beam along the bottom of a ship

synonyms.nuance: The whole body of the ship, not just the bottom beam.

entries.sense_en: to look steadily for a long time, with wonder

synonyms.nuance: Also long, but often rude or blank; gaze feels admiring or dreamy.
One quick look, the opposite of a gaze.
Look closely, usually because it is hard to see.

entries.sense_en: to ring loudly, as bells do

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for any bell sound.
Softer, musical, usually in a clear tone.
Slow, solemn ring, as for a funeral.

entries.sense_en: busy, noisy activity

synonyms.nuance: Fast, pushy energy; often followed by 'and bustle'.
Neutral and calm; has no noise or crowding.

entries.sense_en: a small narrow inlet of water

synonyms.nuance: Small flowing river; a creek can be an inlet from the sea.
Narrow bay running into the land.
Small, pretty stream, mostly British or poetic.

entries.sense_en: to play happily and freely

synonyms.nuance: Lively, joyful play, like children or animals.
Plain everyday word, without extra joy.

entries.tip_ko: 운동 종목이 아니라 '뛰놀다'라는 옛 동사 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: to roll up part of a sail to make it smaller in strong wind

synonyms.nuance: Roll up a sail completely and tie it.
Bring down; reefing keeps the sail up but smaller.

entries.sense_en: very tall and impressive

synonyms.nuance: Suggests looming over you; more dramatic.
Everyday, wide use; lofty adds grandeur.

entries.sense_en: not interested any more; not caring

synonyms.nuance: Stronger: no feeling or energy at all.
Not worried about a possible problem.
synonyms.example: She was unconcerned about the risk.

entries.sense_en: to wind or wrap around something

synonyms.nuance: Almost the same; two things woven together.
Cover something all around; not necessarily spiral.
Wind in rings, like a rope or snake.

entries.sense_en: an elderly widow of high rank

synonyms.nuance: Any woman whose husband has died; no rank implied.
Female head of a family, whether widowed or not.

entries.sense_en: to decorate to make more beautiful

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and general, for rooms, cakes, trees.
Adds extra details, also to stories.
Cover with festive decorations; often 'deck out'.

entries.sense_en: impressive, rich splendor and show
to get rid of something

synonyms.nuance: Quickly free yourself from a burden or illness.

entries.sense_en: had no choice; could not do anything else

synonyms.example: I had no choice but to go.

synonyms.nuance: Says the action is out of your control.

entries.tip_ko: 요즘은 주로 '(하고 싶은 충동을) 참지 못하다'라는 뜻으로 씁니다: I ate the whole cake; I couldn't help myself.

entries.sense_en: unable to move because there is no wind
the ropes and chains that hold up a ship's masts and sails

synonyms.nuance: Ropes and pulleys for lifting or moving loads.

entries.sense_en: suddenly surprised and a little frightened

synonyms.example: I was surprised by the gift.
She was shocked by the news.

entries.sense_en: to unroll and spread out a sail
to break or collapse under pressure

synonyms.nuance: Just split; no idea of pressure.
Often for people who give in.

entries.tip_ko: '양보하다'라는 뜻도 있습니다: give way to traffic.

entries.sense_en: apart, into pieces
to lie scattered over a surface

synonyms.nuance: Cover an area widely; not necessarily messy.

entries.sense_en: the top of a wave

synonyms.nuance: Highest point of a mountain or pattern.

entries.sense_en: a building where nuns live

synonyms.nuance: Large church community for monks or nuns.

entries.sense_en: to become ready to eat
to stop doing something

synonyms.nuance: Stop a job or habit; stronger.
Leave or stop completely, often for good.

entries.sense_en: a large formal room in a palace
a small round dome on a roof
a heavy cloth with pictures woven into it, hung on walls

synonyms.nuance: Any cloth hung on a wall.

entries.sense_en: to ask someone for help or information

synonyms.nuance: Beg or urge, often for help.

entries.tip_ko: 요즘은 'apply to + 학교·회사(~에 지원하다)'의 뜻으로 더 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: a person's chest, where you hold someone dear

synonyms.nuance: More formal; also used poetically for the heart and feelings.

entries.sense_en: to keep something and not lose it
strong and thick

synonyms.nuance: Healthy and strong, often for people or systems.

entries.sense_en: extremely large

synonyms.nuance: Very large, also for abstract things.

entries.sense_en: too many to count

synonyms.nuance: Never stopping, in time or size.

entries.sense_en: a small brass horn used for signals

synonyms.nuance: Larger, with valves; used in bands.

entries.sense_en: advice
water that spins fast and pulls things down

synonyms.nuance: Spinning flow of any fluid or air.

entries.sense_en: wet, sticky mud
sea creatures like plants with grasping arms

synonyms.nuance: A common polyp with flower-like arms.
Colony of polyps with a hard skeleton.

entries.sense_en: bending easily and gracefully
a tight, controlling hold

synonyms.nuance: Reach or hold; less threatening, and can also mean understanding.

entries.sense_en: land ruled by one ruler

synonyms.nuance: Kingdom; also a field of activity.

entries.sense_en: a portion of liquid medicine or magic drink
for the benefit of someone
to hold captive or bind
a large round pot for boiling over a fire
to clean by rubbing hard
a magic drink

synonyms.nuance: Any prepared drink, magic or not.

entries.sense_en: a faint; a sudden loss of consciousness
to dress in fine or splendid clothes
a thin, light cotton cloth
a child found with no known parents

synonyms.nuance: A child whose parents have died.

entries.sense_en: to signal someone to come with a hand
very loyal and loving

synonyms.nuance: Committed to a cause or work.

entries.sense_en: to force someone to do something
the wheel or handle used to steer a ship
a fanfare of loud trumpet music
a formal promise to marry
a container for burning incense in church
to leave for good; to give up
a sudden sharp pain, often of emotion
never known before; extreme
to push something deep and hard into
to make a low sound of grief
light and delicate, almost not of this world
slow to end or leave; long-held
a deadly widespread disease
hot and humid

synonyms.nuance: So hot you can hardly breathe.

entries.sense_en: to get by effort
the clear upper sky
a test period to prove your worth
